text:
maria: Quick coordination thread for the release announcement + Friday benchmark webinar. Need: final changelog URL, docs anchor for the benchmark section, a 2-line methodology blurb for the blog card, and the confirmed rollout schedule so we can sync comms. @ajay @caroline

ajay: Rollout: canary 10% Thu 10:00am PT, ramp 40% Thu 2:30pm, full Fri 9:00am PT if telemetry is green. Ops will run the FF rollout and post statuses here.

caroline: Docs: updated draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-runtime#benchmarks. Changelog: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2026-03-22. Still need the short methodology sentence to anchor the section.

sam: Webinar funnel: can we auto-tag registrants as "bench-rollout-2026" and route to growth SDRs? Need a 1-line registration hook for the confirmation email.

ajay: FF name bench_runtime_v3. Ops command: `ffctl rollout bench_runtime_v3 --steps 10,40,100 --wait 45m`. Rollback trigger: error rate >0.7% sustained 10m or p95 latency +50%. Ops will post timestamps.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary 10% started 1826000300  bench_runtime_v3 enabled for 10% traffic.

elaine: Monitoring: added temporary SLO checks and dashboard panel https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/bench-rollout. Alert if errors spike >0.5% for 5m.

maria: Messaging ask: highlight ~30% unit-cost savings and ~10ms median latency improvement. Ajay, can you confirm numbers we should use externally?

ajay: Internal evals: unit cost down ~28-31% depending on sequence length; median latency improvement ~9-11ms; p95 improvement ~20-25ms in most configs. Methodology: "Measured using 50k synthetic queries plus 12k anonymized production traces (median seq: 128 tokens)." Caveat: "Real-world results vary by model and request distribution."

caroline: Added Ajay's lines into the docs anchor and updated the changelog link. Uploaded doc + assets to the shared comms folder.

sam: Registration blurb suggestion: "See how our new runtime cuts inference costs by ~30% while improving latency  join the live demo and benchmark deep-dive." Growth queue routing confirmed.

maria: Final checklist: pin changelog link in #marketing, upload final slide deck and benchmark CSVs to comms folder, and confirm webinar landing uses exact phrasing above. Drop assets by EOD Wednesday.

ajay: Will post here when ramp hits 40% and again at full roll.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Ramp to 40% successful 1826000500  no error spike observed.

elaine: 40% stable, no alerts. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks everyone  I'll draft announcement copy and tag for review.
